items.text: Berry LOVES Dalton Schultz @ IND: team-high 28% target share last week w/ Collins out; IND 4th-most yards to TEs.
items.why: Collins OUT again; prior 28-30% routes targeted; elite TE matchup.
items.opportunity: Primary target without Collins; high floor/ceiling.

items.text: Berry LOVES Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush prop 88.5; Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs weak run D; high prop.
items.opportunity: Volume and efficiency in Brazil game.

items.text: Berry LOVES Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% target share both games; RB7 util; PIT 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
items.why: Consistent high usage + soft run matchup.

items.text: Berry LOVES Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both weeks, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
items.why: Volume + deep threat vs soft secondary.

items.text: Berry LOVES Christian Watson vs ATL: WR8 util, 38% RZ target share; WR9 PPG since Wk11 last year.
items.why: Elevated usage + red-zone role + solid matchup.

items.text: Berry HATES Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX: 31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble last week; JAX allows only 55 rush ypg to RBs (3.2 YPC).
items.why: Fumble fallout + tough run D; Henderson taking more work.

items.text: Berry HATES Travis Etienne vs LV: only 49% RB touches/38% 3rd-down snaps even w/ Kamara active; role not there (RB37 util).
